name: Iluvatar CoreX BI-V150 (Tiangai 150) — product overview and estimates
notes:
SECONDARY, and the source itself warns that 'Detailed specifications of TianGai 150 are not fully disclosed by official sources.' The BI-V150 is Iluvatar's second-generation cloud GPGPU training accelerator, released 2023, using the ivcore11 architecture on 7nm with 2.5D CoWoS packaging. Estimates (explicitly labeled as such by the source): FP16 150-200 TFLOPS, INT8 300-400 TOPS, memory 32-64 GB HBM2/HBM3, TDP 275 W (estimated) or 350 W (per moark.com). The BI-V150 participated in Zhiyuan Research Institute's Aquila2-70B-Expr hybrid training (120-node BI-V100 + 8-node BI-V150 cluster, 85.3% of theoretical peak). The moark.com page states 350 W peak power. Iluvatar's own website publishes no specifications for this part.
